meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求审查已完成的工作时,它会同时启动 5 个后台子代理,分别核查目标达成、代码质量、安全性、实际运行和上下文遗漏。五个全部通过才算审查通过,任一个失败则整体失败,并给出问题清单。
howto.when: 在提交 PR 交底前,或当你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。触发词如“review work”“review my work”“QA my work”等。

say.note: 触发全部5个子代理并行核查。
偏重实际运行应用来测试。
核查最近改动是否达到目标。

howto.what_en: On request, it spawns 5 background sub-agents checking goal fit, code quality, security, hands-on behavior, and context coverage. All 5 must pass; any failure fails the review and yields an issue list.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Sample triggers: “review work”, “review my work”, “QA my work”, etc.

say_en.note: Launches all 5 sub-agents in parallel for review.
Emphasizes hands-on testing by actually running the app.
Checks whether the changes match the original goal.
